description: Unit tests for the ImmutableSubjectId class, verifying immutability, equality, length constraints, handling of delimiters, invalid input, and special cases.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjectIdTest
classes.description: Test class for ImmutableSubjectId, verifying immutability, equality, length constraints, delimiter handling, and exception cases.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableSubjectId is immutable and that its SubjectIssuer is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations for ImmutableSubjectId.

methods.name: createNewSubjectIdWithNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectId with null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createNewSubjectIdWithEmptyValue
methods.description: Ensures that creating a SubjectId with empty string throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: createNewSubjectIdSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful creation of SubjectId with valid issuer and subject.

methods.name: ignoresUrlDelimiter
methods.description: Checks that URL delimiters in subject IDs are ignored, correctly parsing issuer and subject.

methods.name: subjectIdCanHaveMaximumLengthOf256Characters
methods.description: Verifies that subject IDs can be exactly 256 characters long.

methods.name: subjectIdCannotHaveMoreThan256Characters
methods.description: Ensures that subject IDs exceeding 256 characters throw SubjectIdInvalidException.

methods.name: createInvalidAttribute
methods.description: Checks that invalid attribute characters in subject ID throw SubjectIdInvalidException.

methods.name: handlesNonUrlIssuer
methods.description: Verifies handling of non-URL formatted issuer strings.

methods.name: newSubjectIdWithPlaceholderInputCreatesSubjectIdWithEmptyIssuerAndPlaceholderInputAsSubject
methods.description: Tests creation of SubjectId with placeholder input, resulting in empty issuer and placeholder as subject.
